basics.name: Dhruv Makwana
basics.label: PhD Candidate, Computer Science
basics.summary: I am open to any work at the intersection of elegant abstractions, technical infrastructure problems and readable, working code. So far, I have focused on tooling performance, types, and verification. I’m enthusiastic about supporting others: I’ve trained new hires and mentored interns, given talks, made educational videos, and taught undergrads and children. My publications are available here.
